text.description_html:
KABA E5231 E-Plex Electronic Pushbutton Lock

The KABA E-Plex pushbutton lock eliminates the problems and cost associated with issuing, controlling and collecting keys and cards. Provides exterior access by combination, while allowing free egress. The last 30,000 lock events including the use of key override are stored in memory.

Multiple users with up to 3000 user codes allows for over 100 million possible code combinations. Locks are programed via E-Plex Enterprise software (not included). It fits standard ASA 161 door preparation, easily installs on wood or metal doors. E-Plex's LectroBolt eliminates running wires to or through the door eliminating risk of damage from pinched wires.

Features of KABA E5231

  • 3000 User Code PIN Access Control
  • 30,000 Event Audit Trail
  • 16 Access Schedules
  • 32 Holiday Blocks
  • 5 Authority Access Levels
  • Heavy Duty - ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 (highest grade)
  • 3 Hour Fire Door Rating
  • No wiring to or through the door
  • Tested -35° F (-35° C) to +130° F (55° C) Indoor/Outdoor Use
  • 180,000 Cycles - Battery 4xAA
  • 3 Year Warranty

Specifications of KABA E5231

  • Construction: Extra heavy-duty, cylinder lockset, solid cast housings, solid cast door levers, cylinder drive wear teated for extensive use in indoor and outdoor applications.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 2-1/4"
  • Minimum Stile: 5"
  • Installation: Easily installs on wood or metal doors with standard ASA 161 door preparation.
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Latch: 1/2" throw
  • Handing: Non-handed, field reversible.
  • Numeric Keypad: Vandal resistant, 12-button solid metal pushbuttons
  • ANSI/BHMA Grade 1 Certified
  • Fire Rating: Three (3) hour UL/ULC fire door rating.
  • ADA Compliant
  • Warranty: Three (3) Year warranty for date of installation.
  • Finish: US26D (626) Satin Chrome
  • KABA E-Plex 5200 Series Specifications (PDF)

A KABA lock cylinder (Schlage "C" compatible) is included. Best I/C compatible lever is optional (Best cylinder NOT included).
